name: hexpayrollsys
description: Hex Payroll — offline-first desktop payroll system (Electron + React + Express + PostgreSQL 18)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --success first -n api,web,desktop -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @hexpayroll/api dev" "pnpm --filter @hexpayroll/web dev" "pnpm --filter @hexpayroll/desktop dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hexpayroll/shared build && pnpm --filter @hexpayroll/payroll-engine build && pnpm -r typecheck
